description: Create, schedule, and manage social media posts via Postey across X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Facebook, and Pinterest. The hub: accounts, platform truth, the post lifecycle, and the shared craft layer that decides how a post is written — plus the local-file and large-upload paths the MCP server cannot reach. Content flows ship as optional packs that require this one: install `postey-video` to transcribe a video and turn it into per-platform posts, `postey-ideas` to decide what to post.
